## If this touches a rail

- [ ] I opened an issue first (any change to what a rail catches **or stops catching**)
- [ ] I named the **silenced-lies** case this change keeps green
- [ ] I showed the rail **going red** somewhere — a case that fails without this change
- [ ] The rail is still a **regex or a filesystem check** (CONTRIBUTING rule 1)
- [ ] I did not make the tool cleverer about **intent** (CONTRIBUTING rule 2)

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits carry a sign-off — `git commit -s` (DCO; CI enforces it)
- [ ] One concern per PR
- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] If the version in `pyproject.toml` changed: the tag matches it
- [ ] If a draft that produced no findings now produces some: that is a breaking change and it is noted
